# River City Tree Care

> Tree service and land clearing company based in Chickamauga, GA, owned and operated by Andrew Roberson.

## Business Information
- Name: River City Tree Care (legal name: River City Tree Care, LLC)
- Owner: Andrew Roberson
- Location: Chickamauga, GA 30707
- Phone: (706) 264-6130
- Email: treeclimber1110@gmail.com
- Website: https://rivercitytreega.com/
- Hours: Open 24 hours, 7 days a week, including holidays and emergencies
- Service Area: 50-mile radius from Chickamauga, GA, including Fort Oglethorpe, Ringgold, LaFayette, Rossville, Dalton and Calhoun in Georgia and Chattanooga, TN (Walker, Catoosa, Whitfield and Hamilton counties)
- Licensed and insured (general liability + workers' compensation)
- Estimates: free, on site, in writing

## Services
- Tree Trimming (typically $200–$800 per tree)
- Tree Removal (typically $400–$2,500+)
- Stump Grinding (typically $100–$400 per stump, ground 6–12 inches below grade)
- Lot Clearing (typically $1,500–$8,000+)
- Forestry Mulching
- Land Development clearing
- Firewood (oak, hickory, mixed hardwood, by the truckload)
- Sawmill Services (portable mill, logs 12 in. diameter and 6 ft long or larger)

## About
River City Tree Care is owned and operated by Andrew Roberson out of Chickamauga, GA. Andrew quotes each job and is on site for every project; the company does not use subcontractors. The crew handles work from a single backyard tree to multi-acre clearing, and cleanup is part of every job.
